meaning_en: a ticket for a journey to a place and back
example_en: I'd like a return ticket to London, please.
examples_extra: A return to London, please.
A return costs less than two singles.

meaning_en: something bad that happens by chance
example_en: He had a car accident yesterday.
examples_extra: He broke his leg in a car accident.
The glass fell by accident, not on purpose.
note_fa: «by accident = تصادفی؛ با by می‌آید نه with.»

meaning_en: To come closer to something or someone.
example_en: The train is starting to approach the station.
examples_extra: As we approached the village, we saw smoke from the chimneys.
She approached the teacher to ask for help with her homework.

meaning_en: To ask someone for directions.
example_en: We asked a man the way to the park.
examples_extra: He asked a policeman the way to the hotel.
Don't be shy; just ask somebody the way.

meaning_en: At a distance from a place.
example_en: The shop is 5 miles away.
examples_extra: The beach is two miles away from here.
How far away is the nearest big hospital?
note_fa: فقط برای فاصله: two kilometres away.

meaning_en: A curve in a road or object. To curve.
example_en: Be careful, there's a sharp bend in the road.
examples_extra: The car slowed down at the sharp bend in the road.
The road bends to the right after the bridge.
note_fa: کتاب: a bend in the road؛ the road bends.

meaning_en: A vehicle with two wheels, you pedal it.
example_en: I ride my bicycle to school.
examples_extra: Somebody stole my bicycle from outside the station.
She rides her bicycle to work every morning.
note_fa: اشتباه کتاب: somebody stole my bicycle (نه robbed).

meaning_en: A bicycle.
example_en: Let's ride our bikes to the park.
examples_extra: I hired a bike for the day and rode to the lake.
She goes to school by bike every day.

meaning_en: A device used to slow or stop a vehicle.
example_en: Press the brake pedal to stop the car.
examples_extra: Press the brake pedal to stop the car.
The brakes on his old bike need fixing.

meaning_en: A structure built over water or a road.
example_en: We drove over a long bridge.
examples_extra: We walked slowly across the bridge over the river.
The old stone bridge was built in nineteen hundred.

meaning_en: A large vehicle carrying many people.
example_en: I take the bus to school every day.
examples_extra: I take the crowded bus to school every day.
The morning bus was very late again today.

meaning_en: A place where a bus stops for people.
example_en: I wait for the bus at the bus stop.
examples_extra: There is a bus stop in front of our house.
I waited at the cold bus stop for ten minutes.

meaning_en: To get on a bus or train.
example_en: I need to catch the next bus.
examples_extra: Hurry up, or we won't catch our train.
She catches the same bus to work every morning.

meaning_en: A long bus for carrying many people.
example_en: We took a coach to the beach.
examples_extra: We travelled from Oxford to London by coach.
The experienced coach gave the team new tactics.
note_fa: هم «اتوبوس بین‌شهری» هم «مربی»؛ دو معنای متفاوت.

meaning_en: To say you are unhappy about something.
example_en: I need to complain about the service.
examples_extra: The guests complained about the noise.
She complained to the manager about the cold food.
note_fa: complain about نارضایتی / complain to شکایت به کسی.

meaning_en: A statement that you are unhappy.
example_en: I made a complaint about the food.
examples_extra: He made a complaint about the bad service.
The company received many complaints last month.

meaning_en: Easy to use or suitable for your needs.
example_en: The shop is very convenient for me.
examples_extra: The hotel is in a convenient location near the station.
It is convenient for me to meet you on Friday.

meaning_en: To hit something very hard, causing damage.
example_en: The car crashed into the wall.
examples_extra: The car crashed into a wall.
The plane crashed into the sea.
note_fa: «به شدت برخورد کردن»؛ crash into something.

meaning_en: To ride a bicycle.
example_en: We like to cycle in the park.
examples_extra: He cycles to work every day.
We cycled around the lake on Sunday.

meaning_en: A person who rides a bicycle.
example_en: The cyclist wore a helmet for safety.
examples_extra: The cyclist wore a bright yellow jacket.
Cyclists should always wear helmets.

meaning_en: (n) Harm or injury. (v) To harm or injure something.
example_en: The storm caused a lot of damage.
examples_extra: The storm caused serious damage to the roof.
Smoking can damage your health.
note_fa: در معنای خسارت غیرقابل شمارش است.

meaning_en: To tell someone how to get somewhere.
example_en: Can you direct me to the nearest post office?
examples_extra: Could you direct me to the nearest train station?
The police officer directed the tourists to the museum.
note_fa: یعنی «راهنمایی کردن به سمت»؛ با to می‌آید.

meaning_en: To finally be in a particular place or situation.
example_en: We ended up eating pizza for dinner.
examples_extra: We got lost and ended up in a small village.
He ended up working as a taxi driver.
note_fa: یعنی «آخرش به جایی/وضعیتی رسیدن»؛ بعدش اسم یا ing می‌آید.

meaning_en: The money you pay for a journey.
example_en: How much is the bus fare?
examples_extra: The bus fare has gone up again.
How much is the train fare to London?
note_fa: با fair هم‌آواست ولی معنایش فرق دارد.

meaning_en: A journey by plane.
example_en: Our flight leaves at 7 AM.
examples_extra: Our flight to Istanbul leaves at six in the morning.
The flight was delayed because of the heavy snow.
note_fa: پرواز؛ flight number یعنی شماره پرواز.

meaning_en: To travel through the air, often in a plane.
example_en: Birds can fly very high.
examples_extra: The pilot learned to fly when he was twenty.
We watched the seagulls fly over the harbour.
note_fa: گذشته‌اش flew و اسم مفعولش flown است.

meaning_en: to enter a car, taxi, or small boat.
example_en: Get in the car, we're leaving.
examples_extra: Get in the car quickly.
They got in a taxi.
note_fa: سوار شدن (ماشین/تاکسی کوچک)؛ get on برای اتوبوس/قطار.

meaning_en: to not know where you are.
example_en: We got lost in the big city.
examples_extra: We got lost in the old city.
Be careful not to get lost.
note_fa: گم شدن؛ Get lost! به‌عنوان فحش یعنی «گمشو!».

meaning_en: to leave a bus, train, or plane.
example_en: I get off the bus at the next stop.
examples_extra: We get off at the next stop.
She got off the bus near the park.

meaning_en: to enter a bus, train, or plane.
example_en: Let's get on the bus quickly.
examples_extra: We get on the bus at the corner.
Hurry up and get on the train.

meaning_en: To leave a car, bus, or building.
example_en: Let's get out of the car here.
examples_extra: Get out of the car now.
They got out of the building quickly.
note_fa: خارج شدن/پیاده شدن؛ Get out! یعنی «برو بیرون!».

meaning_en: To travel using a specific type of transport.
example_en: We go to school by bus every day.
examples_extra: She goes to work by bike every day.
They always go by car, not by bus.
note_fa: بعد از by حرف تعریف نمی‌آید: by car، نه by a car.

meaning_en: Physical harm or damage to a body.
example_en: He had a serious injury from the accident.
examples_extra: He missed the final because of a knee injury.
The injury kept her out of work for weeks.

meaning_en: The lane closest to the side of the road.
example_en: Drive in the inside lane on the highway.
examples_extra: Stay in the inside lane on the motorway.
The inside lane is usually slower than the others.
note_fa: لاین داخلی جاده؛ برای سرعت کمتر.

meaning_en: An act of travelling from one place to another.
example_en: Our journey to the mountains was long but beautiful.
examples_extra: The journey took three hours.
Have a safe journey home!

meaning_en: A part of a road for one line of traffic.
example_en: Stay in your lane while driving.
examples_extra: Please stay in your lane while driving.
The bus is in the wrong lane.
note_fa: خط عبور در جاده؛ country lane جاده‌ی روستایی.

meaning_en: a large vehicle for carrying heavy goods.
example_en: The lorry delivered goods to the shop.
examples_extra: A lorry delivered the furniture.
He drives a lorry for a living.
note_fa: بریتانیایی؛ در آمریکا truck گفته می‌شود.

meaning_en: a large, important road connecting towns.
example_en: The house is on a busy main road.
examples_extra: The hotel is on the main road.
Take the main road to the city.
note_fa: جاده اصلی؛ main street یعنی خیابان اصلی شهر.

meaning_en: To arrive too late for transport.
example_en: Hurry up, or we will miss the bus!
examples_extra: Hurry up or you'll miss the bus.
I missed the train by one minute.

meaning_en: The fastest lane on a motorway.
example_en: Drive carefully in the outside lane.
examples_extra: Use the outside lane to overtake.
The outside lane is the fastest.

meaning_en: To go past another vehicle or person.
example_en: Don't overtake on a bend.
examples_extra: It's dangerous to overtake on a bend.
Never overtake near a junction.

meaning_en: Something wrapped to be sent by post.
example_en: I sent a parcel to my friend yesterday.
examples_extra: I sent the parcel by post.
A parcel arrived this morning.

meaning_en: A car that has stopped and is not moving.
example_en: I couldn't find my parked car in the busy street.
examples_extra: A parked car blocked the road.
The parked cars lined the street.

meaning_en: A path for people to walk on next to a road.
example_en: Please walk on the pavement, not in the street.
examples_extra: Walk on the pavement, not the road.
The pavement was wet and slippery.

meaning_en: A person walking in a town or city.
example_en: The pedestrian waited for the light to change.
examples_extra: The car stopped for the pedestrian.
Pedestrians should use the crossing.

meaning_en: A place for people to cross the road safely.
example_en: Always use the pedestrian crossing.
examples_extra: Use the pedestrian crossing to cross.
Wait at the pedestrian crossing.

meaning_en: the area next to a train track.
example_en: The train leaves from platform 3.
examples_extra: The train leaves from platform six.
We waited on the platform.

meaning_en: Buses, trains, etc., for everyone to use.
example_en: I use public transport to get to work.
examples_extra: We use public transport daily.
Public transport is cheap here.

meaning_en: A line of people waiting for something.
example_en: There was a long queue at the bus stop.
examples_extra: There was a long queue at the bank.
Join the queue over there.

meaning_en: Able to be trusted or depended on.
example_en: My car is old but very reliable.
examples_extra: He is a reliable friend; you can trust him.
This car is very reliable and never breaks down.

meaning_en: To travel on a bicycle.
example_en: My brother taught me how to ride a bike.
examples_extra: They ride their bikes to school every day.
She learned to ride a bike at seven.

meaning_en: A sign on the road giving information or warnings.
example_en: Pay attention to the road signs while driving.
examples_extra: The driver ignored the road sign ahead.
New road signs were put up last week.

meaning_en: Very near, happening soon.
example_en: The shop is just round the corner.
examples_extra: Spring is just round the corner.
The shop is right round the corner.

meaning_en: A ticket valid for many journeys over a period.
example_en: I bought a season ticket for the train.
examples_extra: He buys a season ticket every year.
A season ticket saves you money.

meaning_en: A board or notice giving information or a warning.
example_en: Follow the road signs to the airport.
examples_extra: The bright warning sign spoke clearly of danger.
He put up a handwritten sign outside yesterday.

meaning_en: The fastest you can drive.
example_en: The speed limit here is 50 km/h.
examples_extra: The speed limit on this road is fifty.
He was fined for breaking the speed limit.
note_fa: محدودیت سرعت؛ break the speed limit.

meaning_en: To change direction suddenly to avoid something.
example_en: The car had to swerve to miss the dog.
examples_extra: He swerved to avoid the dog.
The car swerved suddenly to the left.

meaning_en: A place where taxis wait for passengers.
example_en: We found a taxi rank near the station.
examples_extra: Taxis wait at the taxi rank.
There's a taxi rank outside.

meaning_en: Lights that control traffic on roads.
example_en: Turn left at the next traffic lights.
examples_extra: You must stop when the traffic lights turn red.
The traffic lights were not working this morning.

meaning_en: A large vehicle for carrying heavy goods.
example_en: The truck delivered furniture to our house.
examples_extra: A truck delivered the goods.
He drives a truck for work.

meaning_en: A place where a road or path changes direction.
example_en: Take the next turning on the right.
examples_extra: Take the second turning on the right.
The turning leads to the village.

meaning_en: a large vehicle for carrying goods or people
example_en: The delivery driver uses a white van.
examples_extra: The van delivered the boxes.
He drives a white van.

meaning_en: a machine that transports people or goods
example_en: A car is a type of vehicle.
examples_extra: All vehicles must stop at the red light.
Electric vehicles are becoming increasingly popular.

meaning_en: by way of; through
example_en: I sent the package via express mail.
examples_extra: We flew to Rome via Paris yesterday.
He sent the urgent message via email today.

meaning_en: A path or road to get somewhere.
example_en: Can you tell me the way to the station?
examples_extra: Excuse me, do you know the way there?
We completely lost our way home tonight.

meaning_en: To make a short, loud sound with a car horn.
example_en: Please don't beep your horn unnecessarily in residential areas.
examples_extra: The driver had to beep his horn at the cyclist.
Do not beep your horn late at night.

meaning_en: A device used to measure alcohol in breath.
example_en: Police used a breathalyser to check for drunk driving.
examples_extra: Police asked him to take a breathalyser test.
The driver failed the breathalyser at the checkpoint.

meaning_en: To fix a device to a wheel to prevent movement.
example_en: My car was clamped for parking illegally.
examples_extra: The police clamped the illegally parked car yesterday.
He clamped the wood firmly to the table.

meaning_en: Overcrowding, especially with traffic.
example_en: Traffic congestion is a major problem in urban areas.
examples_extra: The morning congestion delayed every bus downtown.
Congestion on the motorway added an hour to our trip.
note_fa: به‌ویژه برای ترافیک؛ با «congestion charge» یعنی عوارض ورود به مرکز شهر.

meaning_en: A fee for driving into a city center.
example_en: London introduced a congestion charge to reduce traffic.
examples_extra: Drivers pay a congestion charge to enter the city centre.
The congestion charge reduced traffic in central London.
note_fa: اصطلاح ثابت بریتانیایی برای عوارض ترافیک مرکز شهر.

meaning_en: The act of driving a vehicle after consuming alcohol.
example_en: Drink-driving is a serious offense with severe penalties.
examples_extra: Drink-driving remains a serious criminal offence here.
He was caught drink-driving twice last year.

meaning_en: The act of driving a vehicle under the influence of drugs.
example_en: Drug-driving is just as dangerous as drink-driving.
examples_extra: Drug-driving is strictly illegal everywhere now.
He was arrested last night for drug-driving.

meaning_en: Gases released from an engine as waste.
example_en: New regulations aim to reduce vehicle exhaust emissions.
examples_extra: New laws limit exhaust emissions from cars.
Exhaust emissions harm city air quality.

meaning_en: Allow other traffic to go first.
example_en: You must give way to traffic from the right.
examples_extra: Give way to traffic on the right.
You must give way at the junction.

meaning_en: A road sign indicating to yield to other traffic.
example_en: Look for the give-way sign at the intersection.
examples_extra: Stop at the give-way sign.
She missed the give-way sign.

meaning_en: To have legal priority to proceed.
example_en: Pedestrians always have the right of way.
examples_extra: Pedestrians have the right of way.
The bus has the right of way.

meaning_en: A crash where two vehicles hit front-to-front.
meaning_fa: تصادف شاخ به شاخ، برخورد از روبرو
example_en: Two cars were involved in a head-on collision.
examples_extra: Two cars were in a head-on collision.
The head-on collision injured four.

meaning_en: Involving a driver who leaves the scene of an accident.
meaning_fa: تصادف و فرار، فرار از صحنه
example_en: Police are investigating a hit-and-run accident that injured a pedestrian.
examples_extra: The driver was arrested for a hit-and-run.
It was a hit-and-run accident.

meaning_en: To drive through a traffic light when it is red.
example_en: He got a fine for jumping a red light.
examples_extra: He was fined for jumping a red light.
Jumping a red light is dangerous and illegal.

meaning_en: Done or happening immediately at that place.
example_en: The police issued an on-the-spot fine for speeding.
examples_extra: They gave heavy on-the-spot fines.
She made an on-the-spot decision.

meaning_en: Points added to a driving license for traffic offenses.
example_en: He got penalty points for speeding on the motorway.
examples_extra: He got penalty points for speeding.
Penalty points stay on your licence.

meaning_en: A traffic accident involving many vehicles.
example_en: A major pile-up closed the highway for hours.
examples_extra: A pile-up blocked the motorway.
Fog caused a huge pile-up.

meaning_en: Careless and indifferent to danger or consequences.
example_en: His reckless driving caused a serious accident.
examples_extra: His reckless driving caused the crash.
It was reckless to go alone.

meaning_en: the legal right to proceed before others
example_en: At this intersection, pedestrians always have the right of way.
examples_extra: Pedestrians have the right of way here.
He failed to give right of way.

meaning_en: anger and aggressive behavior by a driver
example_en: Road rage incidents are increasing in busy cities.
examples_extra: Road rage is common in heavy traffic.
The driver was arrested for road rage.

meaning_en: fit and safe to be used on the road
example_en: Ensure your car is roadworthy before a long trip.
examples_extra: Her old car is still roadworthy.
Do you think your bike is roadworthy?

meaning_en: To slide uncontrollably, especially on a slippery surface.
example_en: The car skidded on the icy road.
examples_extra: The car skidded on ice.
Bikes skid on wet leaves.

meaning_en: To press the horn in a vehicle.
example_en: Please sound your horn if you see any danger.
examples_extra: Do not sound your horn here.
He sounded his horn angrily.

meaning_en: A long line of stationary or slow-moving traffic.
example_en: A huge tailback formed after the accident on the motorway.
examples_extra: There was a long tailback on the motorway.
The accident caused a huge tailback.

meaning_en: A charge paid to use a road or bridge.
example_en: We paid a toll to cross the new bridge.
examples_extra: Pay the toll at the bridge.
The toll is two pounds.

meaning_en: An area where illegally parked cars will be removed.
example_en: Don't park here; it's a tow-away zone.
examples_extra: Don't park in a tow-away zone.
The street is a tow-away zone.

meaning_en: The patterned surface on a tyre for grip.
example_en: Worn tyre tread reduces grip, especially in wet conditions.
examples_extra: Check your tyre tread regularly.
The tyre tread is worn.
